name: git-gate
description: Git only when you asked: commits, pushes, pull requests, merges and destructive git commands run only when your latest message (or /ship, /kickoff, or your answer to Claude's question) allowed them; everything else is refused with a note telling Claude to ask. No UI.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names or globs that need an explicit merge go-ahead for merges, pushes and commits landing on them.

prBase.title: PR base per repository
prBase.description: Comma-separated owner/repo=branch pairs; `gh pr create` without --base gets that base.

trustedOrigins.title: Prompt origins that can grant
trustedOrigins.description: Comma-separated prompt origins whose words count as yours: composer (typed), bridge (Remote Control on phone/web), sdk, auto-continuation.
